subject: Vendor onboarding & payment alignment: BrightBeam Systems
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightbeam.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding and payment terms - BrightBeam Systems

Connor,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. BrightBeam is ready to start the vendor onboarding for the integration work next month — attaching our completed onboarding form and W-9 for your records (BrightBeam_Onboarding_Form.pdf, W9_BrightBeam.pdf).

A few items we need clarified so we can align with our treasury schedules:
- Preferred payment term: we typically operate Net 60, would Redwood consider Net 60 for the first 6 months while we ramp?
- PO process: do you require a Redwood PO before the first invoice? If so, what is the PO template and lead time to get a PO number?
- Billing cadence: monthly invoices or per milestone? We prefer monthly.

If Net 60 isn't possible, what alternatives do you offer (e.g., early-pay programs, partial advance, or accelerated remittance)?

Please loop in whoever handles procurement/finance. I can provide an AP contact if needed.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement
BrightBeam Systems
elena.morales@brightbeam.com
attachments: BrightBeam_Onboarding_Form.pdf, W9_BrightBeam.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightbeam.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding and payment terms - BrightBeam Systems

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the forms and the context. CC'ing Marissa from our vendor ops team so she can track onboarding paperwork. A few quick answers: 

- Redwood's standard payment term is Net 30 and we do require a Redwood PO before we process the first invoice.
- We can be flexible for strategic partners; Procurement reviews Net 45 requests case-by-case. Net 60 is unusual for us but we can escalate.
- Billing cadence: monthly invoices are fine and easiest for mapping to our GL.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Marissa, can you confirm the PO lead time and share the Redwood PO template?
2) Elena, please confirm if you can accept Net 45 as a starting point while we evaluate longer terms — Finance sometimes offers an early-pay program as a middle ground (vendor elects shorter payment window for a small fee/discount).

I will also route the onboarding form to our procurement queue. If you have an AP contact, please share and I'll make sure they get looped into the PO flow.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightbeam.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding and payment terms - BrightBeam Systems

Elena — thanks for the onboarding docs. Quick procurement note from Finance:

- PO requirement: We require a completed PO (using our PO_Template_Redwood.xlsx) in our system before the first invoice can be paid. Typical issuance lead time is 3–5 business days after all paperwork is returned.
- Standard terms: Net 30.
- Flexible option: For strategic vendors we can approve Net 45 for an initial 90-day window, provided the vendor returns the onboarding form and remit details and provides a signed PO once it's generated.
- Early-pay alternative: We also offer an optional early-pay program — vendor can elect to receive payment in ~15 days in exchange for a small discount. For BrightBeam we can offer 1.25% discount on the invoice if paid within 15 calendar days (Net 15 early-pay election). Enrollment is optional and can be applied per invoice.

Operational asks to move forward:
1) Please confirm you accept either Net 30 or Net 45 (with possibility to enroll in early-pay).
2) Confirm your AP remit details and preferred invoice delivery email (accounts-payable@brightbeam.com is OK).
3) Return the onboarding form and we will send a DocuSign for registration and then issue a PO. DocuSign link: https://app.redwood.com/docusign/1234abcd.

Once we receive the signed onboarding packet and remit details we'll generate PO# and share expected invoice schedule.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Vendor Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.com
attachments: PO_Template_Redwood.xlsx

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightbeam.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding and payment terms - BrightBeam Systems

Laura / Connor — thanks for the clarity and the DocuSign link. After speaking with our treasury team we can accept Net 45 for the first 90 days to get the integration scheduled. We would like to enroll in the early-pay option on a per-invoice basis when cash allows — the 1.25% for Net 15 is acceptable.

I've attached the completed PO template (PO_Template_Redwood_filled.xlsx) and signed onboarding form via the DocuSign you shared. Our AP contact is accounts-payable@brightbeam.com; remittance: BrightBeam Systems, EIN on W9. Please issue the PO and confirm the PO number so we can submit the first monthly invoice on April 1.

One more question for operations: is there a preferred invoice reference you need on the PDF (project code or GL)? We can add your PO# and a short project code if you give us the format.

Appreciate the cooperation — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement
BrightBeam Systems
attachments: PO_Template_Redwood_filled.xlsx, DocuSign-signed-onboarding.pdf
